name: referenceresolver-one-category-per-name
body: Unresolved keys each unresolved target by its upper-cased name and keeps the category and spelling of the name's earliest site in path-then-source order, so one name reached both as a builtin and as an external target (sys.fn_x() and EXEC sys.fn_x, or XML methods on similarly named columns) yields a single record whose category is the earliest site's. Upgrade if per-category records are needed for one name.
